limitations: Originality is to the best of our knowledge. The generalized quasi t-fine definition, commutative quasinilpotent identity, center-locality, positive-characteristic matrix result, Hensel lifting, and periodic-division-ring theorem are prior art. The claims here are the exact local torsion-lifting criterion, the commutative Henselian residue-field equivalence, the Z_(p) versus Z_p boundary, and the all-size M_n(Z_(p)) obstruction for p>=5. General matrix rings over arbitrary Henselian local bases are not classified. No independent validation is asserted.
provenance: A local torsion-lifting characterization and Henselian residue-field criterion for generalized quasi t-fine rings, with sharp localization/completion and mixed-characteristic matrix consequences.
record_title: Henselian residue criterion for generalized quasi t-fine rings
